description: Source code for a Zephyr driver for the RM67162 display panel, including initialization commands, configuration, and display control functions.

methods.name: rm67162_te_isr_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for the Tearing Effect (TE) GPIO, signals when a TE event occurs.

methods.name: rm67162_init
methods.description: Initializes the RM67162 display panel, configures GPIOs, sends initialization commands, and sets up display parameters.

methods.name: rm67162_write_fb
methods.description: Helper function to write framebuffer data to the display via MIPI DSI interface.

methods.name: rm67162_write
methods.description: Writes a specified buffer to a region of the display, handling address setting and synchronization with TE signal.

methods.name: rm67162_get_capabilities
methods.description: Retrieves display capabilities such as resolution and supported pixel formats.

methods.name: rm67162_set_pixel_format
methods.description: Sets the pixel format (RGB565 or RGB888) for the display.

methods.name: rm67162_set_orientation
methods.description: Sets the display orientation; currently only normal orientation is supported.

methods.name: rm67162_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions such as suspend and resume.
